verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's evidence pack describes a static code-review/analysis product (PR reviews, CLI/IDE review, Deep Scan for vulnerabilities) with no documented sandboxed test-execution environment that isolates testing from production data. In fact, a community report (coderabbit-comm-4) describes an incident where an exploit PR was reviewed but the associated system 'happily execute[d] our code' because it was actually running in production, undercutting any implicit sandbox-isolation claim. There is no first-party doc describing a sandbox/staging execution environment for testing.
